summary: Iter9 — tested 6 new features (back buttons, restaurant cart controls, customer note flow, driver auto-assign, driver accept/decline, driver lockdown). Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass against the deployed preview URL. Frontend: driver-lockdown verified by hitting /, /marketplace, /shops, /restaurants and watching all four redirect to /driver; header confirmed clean (no cart, no search, no Home/Marketplace/Shops/Restaurants nav, brand href='/driver'). Driver Accept/Decline UI verified end-to-end: forced order a84ad08e into 'offered' assigned to driver@demo.com, dashboard rendered driver-accept-a84ad08e + driver-decline-a84ad08e + driver-offer-actions-a84ad08e; clicking Accept removed those buttons and the row moved into normal flow. KitchenDashboard verified for seller1 + restaurant c20c36c6: kitchen-back-btn present and routes back to /seller, kitchen-card-note-a84ad08e renders the amber Note card with text 'TEST_NOTE: Extra ketchup please'. cart-back-btn present on /cart. SellerWalletTab has data-testid='seller-wallet-customer-note' (verified in source — modal-driven; not opened in this run but the wiring matches the request).

minor.issue: Seeded driver password '1234' did NOT match the bcrypt hash in MongoDB on this preview env. Tests were unblocked by resetting the hash. cod.seed_cod() should be idempotent and re-seed the password on startup, or test_credentials.md should be updated. Likely root cause: a prior testing iteration changed/reset this user.

issues: Recurring React warning 'An empty string was passed to the src attribute' on /driver, /seller, /restaurants — defensive src={img || undefined} would silence it. Already flagged in iter8.

action_items: [LOW] Re-seed driver@demo.com password ('1234') deterministically in cod.seed_cod (current seed appears non-idempotent — the hash in this preview no longer matched '1234' until manually reset). Without this, fresh test runs will fail on driver login.
[INFO] No code changes needed for the 6 new features — all are functioning.
critical_code_review_comments: auto_assign_rest_order (cod.py:226) correctly gates on delivery_status in {unassigned, delivery_failed} and skips declined_by drivers — round-robin ordering uses last_offered_at ascending which is the correct least-recently-used semantics.
decline-offer endpoint (cod.py:1185) atomically unassigns + appends to declined_by + tries next driver, and notifies admins only when no next driver — clean control flow.
Frontend DriverGate (App.js:70) is a render-time guard, so a logged-in driver who deep-links to /marketplace lands first on the route then is replaced — acceptable, redirect is immediate.
Header.jsx isDriver branching hides nav, cart, search, and CurrencyToggle and re-points Brand to /driver. Mobile menu is also gated. Looks correct.
RestaurantCheckout.jsx exposes rest-cart-remove/minus/plus/qty per item via item_id — selector pattern matches the spec exactly.
KitchenDashboard kitchen-card-note-{id8} renders an amber-bordered StickyNote card only when the order doc has a non-empty note — confirmed visually.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the flows exercised (driver lockdown, driver accept UI, kitchen note + back button, cart back button)
